name: Key Lime Pie
assumptions: Yield estimated from standard key lime pie recipes using similar ingredient quantities (one 22cm/9-inch tart tin typically serves 8).
Preparation and cooking time summed from instructions (10 min bake crust + 1 min whisk + 3 min whisk + 3 min whisk + 15 min bake + cooling/3hr minimum chill); excludes optional overnight chill.
Digestive biscuits classified as containing wheat (standard UK digestive biscuits include wheat flour).
Icing sugar assumed refined cane/beet sugar with no animal bone char processing specified.
Limes classified as compatible with all listed diets and free of listed allergens.
No tree nuts, peanuts, fish, shellfish, soy, or sesame ingredients listed or implied.
instructions:
Heat the oven to 160C/fan 140C/gas 3. Whizz the biscuits to crumbs in a food processor (or put in a strong plastic bag and bash with a rolling pin). Mix with the melted butter and press into the base and up the sides of a 22cm loose-based tart tin. Bake in the oven for 10 minutes. Remove and cool.
Put the egg yolks in a large bowl and whisk for a minute with electric beaters. Add the condensed milk and whisk for 3 minutes then add the zest and juice and whisk again for 3 minutes. Pour the filling into the cooled base then put back in the oven for 15 minutes. Cool then chill for at least 3 hours or overnight if you like.
When you are ready to serve, carefully remove the pie from the tin and put on a serving plate. To decorate, softly whip together the cream and icing sugar. Dollop or pipe the cream onto the top of the pie and finish with extra lime zest.

ingredients.name: Digestive Biscuits
ingredients.assumptions: Standard digestive biscuits (sweet wheat cookies); values based on typical UK digestive biscuit nutrition for the full 300g package.

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.assumptions: Salted or unsalted butter; full 150g used as melted butter for crust, typical values for pure butter.

ingredients.name: Condensed Milk
ingredients.assumptions: Sweetened condensed milk (full-fat, ~397g can rounded to 400g); standard values for the entire can contents poured into filling.

ingredients.name: Egg Yolks
ingredients.assumptions: 3 large egg yolks only (each ~17g); standard raw egg yolk nutrition applied to edible portion.

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.assumptions: 4 medium limes (~70g each with peel); entire fruit weight including zest and juice used in filling, typical lime nutrition.

ingredients.name: Double Cream
ingredients.assumptions: Heavy/double cream (48% fat); full 300ml (~300g density-adjusted) for topping.

ingredients.name: Icing Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon icing/powdered sugar (~12g); standard granulated sugar-like values for the small amount whipped with cream.

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.assumptions: Extra lime zest 'to serve' (equivalent to zest from ~0.5-1 lime or 20g); small plausible amount for garnish based on recipe context.
